snippet.title: Bloody Duke - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
By Right. By Blood. On October 16th 2026, start Duke Blaise's harrowing journey to reclaim the Phoenix Throne from the enemies of humanity in the Bloody Duke demo!

Wishlist Bloody Duke on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4997610/Bloody_Duke/
